civilopediaText.text: The sister of Enciodes and Ensia Silverash, Enya Silverash was forced to take the grueling test to become the Karlan Saintess, the spiritual leader of Kjerag, under her brother's arrangement. Despite her unwillingness, Enya bore this burden in hopes that she could change the conservative Vine-Bead Court. As the Saintess, she was forbidden from leaving the sacred mountain and spent most of her time conducting religious rituals with the Great Elder. The only person she befriended was Kjarr, the chief maid who is willing to listen to Enya's grudges and sorrows. Unbeknownst to most, Kjarr was actually the human guise of Kjeragandr, the goddess of Kjerag. To remain in contact with Ensia, her younger sister, she often wrote letters and sent them in secret.During the Snowcap Incident, Enya managed to meet her younger sister. During this time, Enciodes proposed appointing Enya as Kjerag's head of state, causing the Browntail and Paleroche clans to believe he planned to depose them. Not wishing to see bloodshed between the three families, Enya used her role as the Karlan Saintess to end the conflict and accepted her new position.As Kjerag's contact with the outside world became more frequent, Enya wished to learn more about it. She sent Kjarr to Rhodes Island to arrange a meeting with a representative of Kazimierz. Seizing the opportunity, Enya quietly left her homeland for a vacation at Rhodes Island. Although the Rhodes Island staff was shocked by the presence of the Karlan Saintess, they accepted Enya as an Operator under the codename 'Pramanix.' She uses her bell to invoke cryokinetic Arts to aid her allies and cripple her foes.
